descriptions.zh:
先获取主播流域名，再调用本接口查询直播录制内容。

本接口的直播录制内容是以一次录制任务维度的，具体录制文件请使用[查询所有录制索引文件](~~2847890~~)和[查询单个录制索引文件](~~2847889~~)接口查询

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Obtain the main streaming domain, and then call this operation to query the recordings of a live stream.

The information returned by this API is organized by recording task. To get information about specific recording files within a task, use the [DescribeLiveStreamRecordIndexFiles](~~2847890~~) and [DescribeLiveStreamRecordIndexFile](~~2847889~~) APIs.

## QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 50 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you will experience service interruptions.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-stream-record-content --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --stream-name liveStream0000 --start-time 2017-12-21T08:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-22T08:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DescribeLiveStreamRecordContent --region cn-hangzhou --StreamName liveStream0000 --EndTime '2017-12-22T08:00:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --StartTime '2017-12-21T08:00:00Z' --AppName liveApp0000
